name: Coca-Cola UNITED - Chattanooga Production Plant, TN

fieldNotes.location: Roster address (2111 Polymer Dr) and roster coords (35.0459,-85.1932) do not match the production plant. The roster label 'Production Plant' corresponds to the Coca-Cola UNITED Chattanooga PRODUCTION CENTER at 4000 Amnicola Hwy, Chattanooga TN 37406 (Coca-Cola UNITED Chattanooga-2 location page; Google Maps place pin 35.0923,-85.2532). Note: 2111 W Shepherd Rd is a SEPARATE Coca-Cola UNITED distribution center/regional HQ - the roster's '2111 Polymer Dr' appears to conflate the two. Confirmed the Amnicola plant by Street View showing Coca-Cola script branding on the building facade plus a 'TRUCK DELIVERY' wayfinding sign.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck/dock yard is enclosed by chain-link fencing; Street View shows the dock yard fenced with gate sections and trailers backed into docks inside. Trucks enter the fenced yard via a gated opening off the internal west-side road - recorded truckGate true. Flagged uncertain as the gate hardware (barrier vs rolling gate) is partly tree-obscured.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone guard booth seen at the truck-yard gate. The main building entrance off Amnicola Hwy is an open driveway. Recorded false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present without a staffed booth implies kiosk/remote check-in - recorded remoteGs true (flagged uncertain alongside truckGate).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated ~35 dock doors across the west and south building faces with trailers backed in; banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop yard on the south side holds ~30 trailers in rows; banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Internal paved staging/parking area south and west of the building between the gate and the docks.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep internal approach - the access road plus internal yard easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Site is a campus: main production/warehouse building, office wing fronting Amnicola Hwy, plus separate support buildings (equipment refurbishment center / shop). Coca-Cola UNITED describes the Chattanooga site as a production center with multiple functions.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property - the plant is bordered by Amnicola Hwy and the Tennessee River.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the Chattanooga metro industrial fabric along Amnicola Hwy - Urban.
